# FarmDirect Marketplace

> FarmDirect is a direct farmer-to-consumer marketplace connecting rural farmers directly with buyers.

## Key Features
- Direct crop purchasing from farmers
- Real-time chat with farmers
- Secure payments via Razorpay
- Verified farmer profiles

## Project Structure
- Frontend: React + Vite + Tailwind CSS
- Backend: Express + MongoDB + Socket.io

## Pages
- `/` - Home Page
- `/marketplace` - Browse all available crops
- `/crop/[id]` - View crop details
- `/auth/login` - User authentication
- `/farmer/dashboard` - Farmer management panel
- `/buyer/dashboard` - Buyer order tracking

## API
- Authentication via JWT
- Real-time updates via WebSockets
